en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. `Ali b. Ibrahim (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Yasir.
He said: When al-Rida (as) became the crown prince, he raised his hands to the sky and I heard him say:
O Allah! Surely, You know that I dislike and despair this.
So, do not hold me accountable, just as You did not hold Your servant and prophet Yusuf accountable when he came into power in Egypt.
